local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local part = script.Parent
local clickDetector = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
local popSound = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

local originalSize = mesh and mesh.Scale or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
local originalTransparency = part.Transparency
local originalColor = part.Color

part:SetAttribute("Popped", false)
part:SetAttribute("State", "Intact")

local isBusy = false

local function onReset()
	isBusy = false
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", false)
	part:SetAttribute("State", "Intact")
	if clickDetector then
		clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 32
	end
	if mesh then
		mesh.Scale = originalSize
	end
	part.Transparency = originalTransparency
	part.Color = originalColor
end

local function onPop(player)
	if isBusy or part:GetAttribute("Popped") == true then
		return
	end
	isBusy = true
	part:SetAttribute("State", "Pressing")
	if clickDetector then
		clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 0
	end

	-- Phase 1: Visible depression
	if mesh then
		local depressTween = TweenService:Create(mesh, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Scale = Vector3.new(originalSize.X * 1.1, originalSize.Y * 0.4, originalSize.Z * 1.1)
		})
		depressTween:Play()
		depressTween.Completed:Wait()
	else
		task.wait(0.08)
	end

	-- Phase 2: Distinct pop moment with synchronized audio
	part:SetAttribute("State", "Popping")
	if popSound then
		popSound:Play()
	end

	-- Phase 3: Settle into recessed collapsed state
	if mesh then
		local settleTween = TweenService:Create(mesh, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Scale = Vector3.new(originalSize.X * 0.9, originalSize.Y * 0.15, originalSize.Z * 0.9)
		})
		settleTween:Play()
		settleTween.Completed:Wait()
	else
		task.wait(0.12)
	end

	part.Transparency = math.clamp(originalTransparency + 0.35, 0, 0.85)
	part:SetAttribute("State", "Popped")
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", true)
	isBusy = false
end
	if clickDetector then
	clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(onPop)
end

part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ResetTrigger"):Connect(onReset)
